newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends weaker on fund liquidation.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends weaker on fund liquidation.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures closed lower on fund liquidation amid thin and rangebound dealings, floor sources said.

Fund buying had carried the market to recent highs last week, but the funds took profits and pressured prices lower. That action continued today, and accelerated once December fell below 75.80, a trader said.

The December contract settled barely below the key level at 75.68, off 0.51, having ranged from 75.90 to 75.30. Spot October finished 0.72 weaker at 74.78, while the back months closed 0.61 lower to 0.20 lower.

Market sources anticipate similar activity ahead of the U.S. Department of Agriculture's supply and demand report, released October 11, and amid a neutral fundamental outlook that includes a balanced world supply and demand picture and no nearby weather problems.
They pegged the recent trading range between 73.00 to 78.00 cents a lb.
